'''Jovel Nial''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Trellev Aquem]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a scion of the [[Clan Nial]], an expansive family of Bothan [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] with roots set down all over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the government, and beyond. It was Jovel Nial's family who had arranged for her to work with Aquem. When the senator discovered her [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] talents, he chose to keep it a secret so he could make use of it. While working for Aquem, Nial also served the interests of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], which pulled the strings of the politician.<ref name="Under a Black Sun" />
